items.answer: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes take effect at the start of your next billing cycle.

items.question: Is there a free trial?
items.answer: Yes! Our Free plan gives you access to basic features with no time limit. You can upgrade to Professional or Enterprise whenever you're ready.

about.title: About DeepTools
about.subtitle: Empowering the world's professionals with intelligent solutions

story.title: Our Story
story.content: Founded in 2024, DeepTools was born from a simple observation: modern professionals spend too much time on repetitive tasks that could be automated. Our team of experienced engineers, designers, and AI researchers came together to build the tools we wished we had.
story.content2: Today, we serve over 10,000 professionals worldwide, helping them automate complex workflows, optimize performance, and focus on what truly matters — building great products.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: To democratize intelligent automation by providing advanced digital tools that are accessible, reliable, and built for real-world production environments.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.content: A world where every professional has access to intelligent automation, allowing them to focus on innovation rather than maintenance.
